$comment: Charter §7 'Floor' — the committed baseline for scripts/check-footprint-budget.mjs (exploration 0434). Raising a value here is a deliberate decision that must be explained in the commit that does it; run the gate with --update to record one.

floor.description: a 2017-class laptop, dual-core x86-64, 8 GB RAM
floor.why: the oldest OS our shell supports — Electron 33 ships Chromium 130. The floor is set by an explicit commitment, not by whatever an Electron major happens to require next; moving it is a reviewed change to docs/CHARTER.md §7.

web.initial-bytes-gzip.note: index.html plus every script, modulepreload and stylesheet it references — what a cold visit pays before anything renders. Recorded as-found, not as-desired: 1.9 MB is heavy for the declared floor, and freezing it is the point of a ratchet. This number should go down.

floor.cold-open-ms.unit: ms on the declared floor device
floor.cold-open-ms.note: no cloud runner is a 2017 laptop, so this is measured by hand, quarterly. Disclosed as pending rather than filled with a number from faster hardware — a plausible-looking figure measured somewhere else would be worse than an empty one.

floor.peak-rss-mb.unit: MB resident, steady state on the declared floor device
floor.peak-rss-mb.note: same reason as cold-open. 8 GB is the floor, so the number that matters is headroom on that machine, not RSS on a CI runner.
